text: Tick ~3887: right after F founded the settlement, the settlement's floating name label ('0 here, 0/8 residents') renders huge at the top and is half-hidden behind the chronicle panel; the objective panel still says 'Objective 4 Found a settlement' (not yet ticked over).

Tick 8359: Lost traveller event, chose 'Share a meal for the map (1 food)'. Feedback is clear: apples 40->39, toast + chronicle say a map marks stone and a cache ~160 paces south-east. But no marker/waypoint appears on screen or compass, so the 'map' is just text; also Objective 5 'Enter your settlement' still shows incomplete though I entered it with E at tick 5515.

Objective 5 'Enter your settlement' only completed on my 2nd entry (E at tick 8495, left with Escape). First entry at tick 5515 (E, then left with the 'Exit Settlement' button at ~5543) did not complete it, although the settlement screen said 'Entered settlement.'

Tick 9423: after buying the traveller's map I headed out to look for the 'stone and cache 160 paces south-east'. There is no marker, waypoint, compass arrow or distance readout anywhere on the HUD; the only direction cue is 'Facing: north-east' in Player Info. 'Paces' are not a unit shown anywhere else in the game, so the reward can't be followed from what's on screen.
